nowplaying.songChanged.description: Runs when a new song starts in your music player or on Spotify. Great for a "Now playing: …" message in chat. Tick "Watch what plays" on the Music page first.

fields.player: Only react to one player: type part of its name, like spotify or vlc. Leave it empty to react to every player.

variables.title: The song's name, like "Never Gonna Give You Up"
variables.artist: Who sings or plays it, like "Rick Astley" (several artists are joined with commas)
variables.album: The album the song is on (empty when the player does not say)
variables.player: The player it plays in, like Spotify, VLC or Firefox
variables.artUrl: A link to the cover picture, when the player gives one
variables.duration: How long the song is, in seconds (0 when unknown)
variables.durationText: How long the song is, written like 3:45
variables.link: A web link to the song (Spotify songs only)
variables.source: "system" for a player on this computer, "spotify" for your Spotify account
variables.nowPlaying.title: The same values again with nowPlaying. in front, so the same message works with the "Get now playing" step

nowplaying.get.description: Looks at what song plays right now and saves it in variables. Use it for a !song command: add this step, then send "Now playing: %nowPlaying.title% by %nowPlaying.artist%".

variables.nowPlaying.title: The song's name (empty when nothing plays)
variables.nowPlaying.album: The album (empty when the player does not say)
variables.nowPlaying.player: The player it plays in, like Spotify or VLC
variables.nowPlaying.durationText: How long the song is, written like 3:45
variables.nowPlaying.link: A web link to the song (Spotify songs only)
variables.nowPlaying.playing: True while it plays, False when it is paused
variables.nowPlaying.found: True when a song was found, False when nothing plays (check it with an If step)

nowplaying.mediaControl.description: Presses a media button on your music player: play or pause, next song or previous song. Works with players on this computer and with Spotify.

fields.command: Which button to press. "Play / pause" pauses when music plays and plays when it is paused.
fields.player: Which player to press it on: part of its name, like vlc or spotify. Leave it empty for the one that plays now.

variables.nowPlaying.player: The player that got the button press
